js.home: const cate=env.get("category"); const page=env.get("page"); const url=`${env.baseUrl}/show/${cate}--------${page}---`; const html=await (0,utils_1.req)(url); const $=utils_1.kitty.load(html); const out=[]; $("a").toArray().forEach(item=>{ const a=$(item); const href=a.attr("href")??""; if(!/^\/GV\d+\/?$/.test(href)) return; const img=a.find("img"); let cover=img.attr("data-src")??img.attr("data-original")??img.attr("src")??""; if(cover.startsWith("//")) cover="https:"+cover; else if(cover.startsWith("/")) cover=env.baseUrl+cover; const title=(a.attr("title")??img.attr("alt")??a.text()??"").trim(); if(!title) return; const remark=(a.find(".pic-text,.remarks,.module-item-note,.video-serial").text()??"").trim(); if(!out.some(x=>x.id===href)) out.push({id:href,title,cover,remark}); }); return out
js.search: const wd=env.get("keyword"); const page=env.get("page"); const url=`${env.baseUrl}/search/${encodeURIComponent(wd)}----------${page}---`; const html=await (0,utils_1.req)(url); const $=utils_1.kitty.load(html); const out=[]; $("a").toArray().forEach(item=>{ const a=$(item); const href=a.attr("href")??""; if(!/^\/GV\d+\/?$/.test(href)) return; const img=a.find("img"); let cover=img.attr("data-src")??img.attr("data-original")??img.attr("src")??""; if(cover.startsWith("//")) cover="https:"+cover; else if(cover.startsWith("/")) cover=env.baseUrl+cover; const title=(a.attr("title")??img.attr("alt")??a.text()??"").trim(); if(!title) return; if(!out.some(x=>x.id===href)) out.push({id:href,title,cover,remark:""}); }); return out
js.detail: const id=env.get("movieId"); const url=id.startsWith("http")?id:`${env.baseUrl}${id}`; const html=await (0,utils_1.req)(url); const $=utils_1.kitty.load(html); let cover=""; $("img").toArray().some(item=>{ const img=$(item); const alt=(img.attr("alt")??"").trim(); let src=img.attr("data-src")??img.attr("data-original")??img.attr("src")??""; if(!src) return false; if(src.startsWith("//")) src="https:"+src; else if(src.startsWith("/")) src=env.baseUrl+src; if(alt && alt!=="海报图"){ cover=src; return true; } if(!cover) cover=src; return false; }); let desc=($("meta[name='description']").attr("content")??"").trim(); const videos=[]; $("a").toArray().forEach(item=>{ const a=$(item); const href=a.attr("href")??""; if(!/^\/playGV\d+-\d+-\d+\/?$/.test(href)) return; const text=(a.text()??"").trim()||`第${videos.length+1}集`; if(!videos.some(x=>x.id===href)) videos.push({id:href,text}); }); return {cover,desc,playlist:[{title:"播放",videos}]}
